result.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
result.fit_rationale: Moderate fit. The candidate brings expert-level Python, historical expert-level C++, and strong performance optimization and debugging experience from large-scale monitoring and migration work. Practical AI projects and AI-assisted development align with the role's AI-training domain, but the role is fundamentally a senior software engineering position requiring current software development breadth, RL environment creation, and CLI/DevOps tooling such as Docker, GDB, ASan, and CI/CD, where direct evidence is limited.
strengths: Expert Python with strong automation, ETL, and data engineering depth.
Historical expert C++ from performance-critical migration and optimization work.
Deep performance engineering and bottleneck analysis experience.
Practical AI experience including agentic workflows, RAG, LLM scoring, and AI-assisted development.
Targets selective remote part-time consulting, matching the engagement model.
gaps: No direct experience with Reinforcement Learning environment design or AI model evaluation.
No listed evidence of Docker, GDB, ASan, FFmpeg, or similar CLI-based reproducible environment tooling.
Limited current software engineering evidence for feature development, refactoring, and code review at scale.
No explicit DevOps/CI/CD experience in the provided evidence.
C++ expertise appears historical rather than current production practice.
tailoring_plan: Lead with Python and C++ performance optimization achievements, especially the Oracle RAC/C++ migration work.
Translate performance engineering and anomaly detection experience into debugging and code-quality examples.
Add any real experience with Git, Docker, CLI tooling, CI/CD, or reproducible environments; do not claim unlisted tools.
Position AI-assisted projects as evidence of practical AI workflow understanding, not as RL expertise.
Acknowledge the RL/evaluation-learning curve and emphasize rapid technical learning and rigorous validation habits.
